licence.title: From booking to badge in 5 steps

steps.title: Book and prepare
steps.text: Choose your date, get your first aid sorted and use your free mock exams.

steps.title: Pass the course
steps.text: Complete 6 days of training and pass your exams and practical assessments.

steps.title: Apply to the SIA
steps.text: Create an account and apply online on GOV.UK once your results are uploaded.

steps.title: ID and checks
steps.text: Pay the licence fee and confirm your identity. The SIA checks your criminal record and right to work.

steps.title: Start working
steps.text: Your licence typically arrives by post within around 25 working days. It's valid for 3 years.

careers.title: Career and earning potential
careers.text: Typical hourly rates for licensed door supervisors range from around £13 to £18+, depending on location, venue and shift pattern. Event, night and specialist work often pays more.
areas: Hospitality and nightlife: clubs, bars, pubs, hotels and restaurants
Events and festivals: concerts, stadiums, exhibitions and sport
Retail: stores, supermarkets and shopping centres
Corporate: offices, reception and access control
Transport hubs: airports, rail and bus stations
Leisure: casinos, cinemas, theatres and venues
Industrial and sites: warehouses, logistics and construction
careers.roles: Typical roles include door supervisor, event security, retail security, loss prevention and corporate security officer, with security supervisor as the next step.
